parsed.explanation: Documented active enforcement of morality/indecency laws against trans women, with 84 arrests in 2024-25, mass convictions to 4.5 years upheld on appeal, beatings and forced anal examinations, and systemic birth-sex processing in detention. No traveller protection machinery is documented. If outed, arrest, imprisonment and custodial abuse are credible and patterned, not hypothetical; capital punishment is not documented, which keeps the rating above 0.05.

entry_documents.exposure: Passport/presentation mismatch can trigger morality questioning; no documented traveller document-acceptance rule. Status uncertain for border practice.
entry_documents.interaction: Border or police document check can flow into Article 226/230 investigation and detention.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Documented detainee beatings, forced anal examinations, humiliating treatment; trans women processed under former names/birth gender from arrest through prison, described as systemic.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. 2017 pledge to stop forced tests did not stop courts ordering them in 2018-2019.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Arrest for gender expression leads to birth-sex custody, increasing assault and identity-refusal exposure.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: No facility-access protection documented; custodial placement by birth sex is documented.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: State custody and any sex-segregated facility encounter follow birth-sex records, not identity.

care_services.exposure: Forced examinations documented as police evidence practice; no visitor care-continuity protection documented.
care_services.interaction: Medical settings can become sites of forced examination or disclosure to authorities.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Article 230 up to 3 years actively enforced; Article 226 applied to gender expression; 84 mainly gay men/trans women arrested Sep 2024-Jan 2025, convicted up to 4.5 years.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Not documented. Official statements oppose same-sex marriage and support punishment, per secondary factors.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Morality law is used as the operative lever against visibly gender-nonconforming visitors, not a dead letter.

minors_guardians.exposure: Not documented as a distinct minor rule; a travelling guardian faces the same arrest/detention exposure, risking separation and loss of care for a minor.
minors_guardians.interaction: Guardian detention interacts with the unspecified minor-care regime; no shielding for travelling families is documented.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Police are documented perpetrators of beatings and humiliation during enforcement; reports of public/family violence lack figures, dates and denominators.
street_violence_police_response.protection: No documented effective police protection for trans victims; appeals upheld mass convictions.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Street visibility can trigger police morality enforcement rather than protection.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Legal gender recognition is court-by-court and often denied, but that is resident-facing; traveller remedies for morality prosecution are not shown to work.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Not documented for visitors. Resident LGR inconsistency is only a climate signal.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Unsettled recognition increases document-mismatch exposure, while courts enforcing hostile morality law provide no operative remedy.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: criminalised presentation/morality enforcement, routine arrest, custodial beatings, illusory recourse and imprisonment. Capital punishment is not documented here, but documented 4.5-year sentences and forced examinations match this tier.

Lower than 0.25: that anchor has rare imprisonment, some successful appeals and short custody. Here mass convictions were upheld, forced examinations and beatings are documented, and birth-sex custody is systemic.
Higher than 0.05: no execution, lethal custody deaths or capital prosecution for gender presentation are documented. The documented worst case is imprisonment with abuse, not a proven lethal pathway.
Materially lower than 0.35: exclusion without imprisonment there; here documented imprisonment, physical abuse and forced examinations make consequences after outing substantially more severe.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime: national morality/sodomy laws, actively enforced in the capital and other cities, are the central traveller exposure. Document inspection or public visibility can lead to investigation, forced examination, detention under birth-sex identity, prosecution and multi-year imprisonment, with appeals upheld in the 2024-25 sweep. No operative state/local protective regime, facility, care or remedy is documented to interrupt that chain. For families, guardian detention is the documented pathway; distinct minor protections are not documented.
